recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-20629 unless a future tracker requests a broader redesign of the HTTP summary tables.
issue_request: FHIR-20629 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to remove ETag from the read interaction's request Conditional column in the HTTP summary table because ETag is a response header; request conditionals should use If-Match/If-None-Match style headers instead.
initial_application: The requested change was applied by git commit c4347b18db67b41f314989c97e930b022ca892b3, which removed ETag from the read request Conditional cell in source/http.html. Jira comments identify PR #1729 and note merge through R5 PR #1731.
additional_context: source/http.html is current build-scope source for the RESTful API page because publish.ini maps http.html to the http page and source/documentation.html links it as RESTful API (HTTP). The current summary section separates request and response headers: the read request row lists If-Modified-Since and If-None-Match, while the read response row lists ETag and Last-Modified. A Zulip FHIR-I block-vote thread lists FHIR-20629 among the vote items, and no Confluence reference or conflicting community discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the Jira resolution and no further source edit is warranted.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reporting that the HTTP summary table incorrectly listed ETag as a read request conditional header.
evidence_items.learned: The final approved request was to remove ETag from the request section because ETag belongs on responses while requests use If-Match or If-None-Match style conditionals.

evidence_items.summary: The Fix FHIR-20629 commit removed ETag from the read interaction's request Conditional cell in source/http.html.
evidence_items.learned: The requested change was directly applied in source before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: The current summary request table lists If-Modified-Since and If-None-Match for read conditionals, while the response table lists ETag and Last-Modified for read versioning.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already implements the requested request/response header distinction.

evidence_items.summary: publish.ini maps http.html to the http page, and documentation.html links http.html as RESTful API (HTTP).
evidence_items.learned: source/http.html is part of the current FHIR build surface.

evidence_items.summary: The 2020-04-08 block-vote announcement lists J#20629 Clean up http summary table among the FHIR-I vote items.
evidence_items.learned: This is consistent with the Jira vote context and does not expand the requested source change.

evidence_items.locator: Confluence and community search for FHIR-20629 HTTP summary header terms
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search sql "SELECT id, stream_name, topic, sender_name, datetime(timestamp, 'unixepoch') AS sent_at, substr(content,1,180) AS excerpt FROM messages WHERE content LIKE '%FHIR-20629%' OR (content LIKE '%ETag%' AND content LIKE '%Last-Modified%' AND content LIKE '%summary%' AND content LIKE '%http%') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10"; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-20629; bun run confluence:search fts 'ETag summary HTTP' --limit 10
evidence_items.query: FHIR-20629; ETag Last-Modified summary http; ETag summary HTTP
evidence_items.summary: Zulip found only the FHIR-I block-vote thread; Confluence refs found no FHIR-20629 references and Confluence FTS found no ETag summary HTTP results.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community record conflicts with the Jira/source-history conclusion.

evidence_items.command: git -c core.whitespace=blank-at-eol,blank-at-eof,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol diff --check -- source/http.html publish.ini source/documentation.html; rg -n 'If-Modified-Since|If-None-Match|ETag|Last-Modified|^http\.html\s*=\s*http|href="http\.html"' source/http.html publish.ini source/documentation.html
evidence_items.summary: The current source has the expected read request conditional row, the read response ETag/Last-Modified row, and build-scope references; no source diff exists for this audit.
evidence_items.learned: No additional edit is required to satisfy FHIR-20629.
